{{Quote|Hurry up!''"<br />"''Why don't you go on a diet?|Umwak and the Dulok squabble|<ref name="THV" />}}
A [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] served as the '''sidekick''' of the Dulok [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Umwak]] and participated in a raid on the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Accompanying Dulok [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] and Umwak, they hoped to [[Thief/Legends|steal]] [[Ewok soap|soap]] to protect themselves from [[Insect/Legends|bugs]]. They managed to find a bar of soap and stole it, though unbeknownst to them, it was instead [[shadowroot soap]], which made its users invisible.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Finding a bar of soap in all this mess ain't gonna be easy.|The Dulok|<ref name="THV" />}}
[[File:UmwakandDulokScout-THV.png|thumb|left|275px|Umwak and the Dulok after the vial of liquid spilled]]
A [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] as part of a [[Gorneesh's tribe|Dulok tribe]].<ref name="THV" /> The Dulok was the sidekick to the Dulok [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Umwak]].<ref name="Book">[[The Haunted Village (book)|''The Haunted Village'' picture book]]</ref> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{EwoksDate|the appearance of the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]]|The Haunted Village}}</ref> the Dulok accompanied Dulok [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] and Umwak on a clandestine raid on [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] on Endor, in search of the Ewoks' [[Ewok soap|soap]] so they could use it as [[Insect/Legends|bug]] repellent. While Gorneesh waited below, the Dulok carried Umwak up a [[Vine/Legends|vine]], arguing all the while, to the platforms of the village and sneaked into the hut of [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], the Ewok medicine man. While searching, the Dulok played with Logray's [[crystal image spinner]], which annoyed Umwak, and the Dulok also checked a scaly [[Color/Legends|green]] creature's [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], jumping back when another creature leaped out from inside.<ref name="THV" />

Umwak used the Dulok to check a vial of steamy liquid, which tidied the Dulok's face and turned the [[Hair/Legends|hair]] thereon a shiny gold. Umwak became annoyed that there was none left, re-scruffying the other Dulok's face. They soon after found a bar of soap, inadvertently [[Thief/Legends|stealing]] [[shadowroot soap]], which made those who used it invisible. The pair climbed back down the vine, bickering again until Gorneesh yanked them down to the ground. He took the soap and began to return home, with the other Duloks begging him to save some soap for them.<ref name="THV" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Hey shaman, look!''"<br />"''This is no time to play.|The Dulok and Umwak|<ref name="THV" />}}
The Dulok was prone to arguing with Umwak and was easily distracted during their mission to steal the soap. The Dulok was pooped after having carried Umwak up the vine. The sidekick had green fur and light red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="THV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Umwak's sidekick first appeared in "[[The Haunted Village]]," the second episode of the [[Ewoks: Season One|first season]] of the animated series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']],<ref name="THV" /> which aired on [[September 14]], [[1985]].<ref name="This Week Mandalorian Trailer">{{ThisWeek|aiAduF3PI8E|The Mandalorian Trailer, Tales from the Galaxy's Edge Updates, and More!|sw_url=video/the-mandalorian-trailer-tales-from-the-galaxy-s-edge-updates-and-more}}</ref>
